# Gadget

> > Gadget is a full-stack development platform for building Shopify and BigCommerce apps with serverless infrastructure, React, and integrated tooling.

Gadget provides developers with a complete framework for rapid app development, featuring built-in authentication, database models, actions, HTTP routes with Fastify, and frontend support through React and Remix. The platform specializes in e-commerce integrations with Shopify and BigCommerce.

## Key Topics

- Gadget platform
- Shopify app development
- BigCommerce integration
- Full-stack framework
- Serverless infrastructure
- React and Remix
- HTTP routes and Fastify
- GraphQL API
- Authentication helpers
- Actions and models
- Developer tools
- Tailwind CSS
- Gelly (GraphQL client)
- E-commerce apps
- Webhooks

## Getting Started

- [Docs Home Page](https://docs.gadget.dev): Main documentation hub for Gadget framework with guides and API reference
- [Getting Started Home](https://docs.gadget.dev/guides/getting-started): Getting started hub with quickstarts for Shopify, BigCommerce, and web apps
- [Guides](https://docs.gadget.dev/guides): Comprehensive guides covering Gadget fundamentals, Shopify/BigCommerce apps
- [Tutorials](https://docs.gadget.dev/guides/tutorials): Step-by-step tutorials for building Shopify, BigCommerce, and web apps

## Core Concepts & Guides

- [Writing Actions](https://docs.gadget.dev/guides/actions/writing-actions): Guide to writing Gadget actions for data modification and business logic
- [HTTP Routes Overview](https://docs.gadget.dev/guides/http-routes): Guide to HTTP routes in Gadget using Fastify for webhooks and requests
- [Authentication Helpers](https://docs.gadget.dev/guides/plugins/authentication/helpers): Authentication helpers for user model, OAuth triggers, and password reset

## Solutions & Use Cases

- [App Developers](https://gadget.dev/solutions/app-developers): Full-stack platform for rapid app development with serverless infrastructure
- [How to: Listen to a 3rd Party Webhook](https://gadget.dev/blog/how-to-listen-to-a-3rd-party-webhook-in-gadget): Tutorial on setting up GitHub webhook listeners using Gadget HTTP routes
- [Build a VAT Validation Shopify App](https://gadget.dev/blog/guide-build-a-vat-validation-shopify-app-with-gadget): Tutorial for building Shopify checkout UI extension with VAT validation
